page: Microsoft Azure EC2eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This server features an x86_64 Intel processor with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include any graphics processing units.

For local storage, the instance is equipped with a 118 GB NVMe SSD. It is also premium storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. The configuration does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the EC2eds_v6 offers a cost-efficient profile for memory-intensive workloads that require a small CPU footprint but benefit from dedicated compute resources and local high-speed solid-state storage. This hardware configuration is suitable for small-scale databases, caching layers, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
